theorems.name: Submission.mvk_integral_radial_fderiv_eq_neg_laplacian
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ρ Ψ h : Rn n → ℝ) (x₀ : Rn n) (σ : ℝ), σ ≠ 0 → ContDiff ℝ 2 h → ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ → (∀ z : Rn n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → Ψ z = 0) → (∀ z v : Rn n, fderiv ℝ Ψ z v = ρ z * inner ℝ z v) → ∫ z, ρ z * fderiv ℝ h (x₀ + σ • z) z = -σ * ∫ z, Laplacian.laplacian h (x₀ + σ • z) * Ψ z
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
